steps.name: Open a species
steps.do: Open **African Lion** (or another known seed animal).
steps.expect: Species detail shows, including **View on Map**.

steps.name: View on Map
steps.expect: You land on the map page.

steps.name: Map focuses the animal
steps.do: Watch the map after it loads.
steps.expect: The map pans/zooms to **African Lion**; its tooltip opens.

steps.name: Stay usable after focus
steps.do: Dismiss the tooltip if needed, then pan/zoom the map.

steps.name: Bottom nav still works
steps.do: Use bottom nav to go to **Itinerary**, then back to **Map**.
steps.expect: Navigation works; map loads normally without forcing another focus.
